title: Orbital Pivot: Console navigation decomposition and compact workspace switcher prototype
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Replace the current top-heavy workspace/navigation patterns with a compact, persistent left pivot that supports fast workspace switching, per-route cost lenses, and rollout state awareness without adding cognitive load. This ticket contains the primary prototype and the decomposition of the navigation into three independent layers: 1) global workspace selector and identity surface; 2) route cluster rail (primary product areas like Models, Deployments, Dashboards, Billing); 3) contextual micro-rail for per-route actions (rollouts, traces, cost breakdowns). The prototype explores a compressed collapsed state (icon-only), focused state (expanded icons + micro-labels), and a transient overlay for quick workspace switching with fuzzy search. Key constraints: preserve token-level cost visibility in Dashboards route, support canary/cascade rollout indicators in the rail, maintain 60px touch targets for mobile breakpoints, and ensure route persistence across private/dedicated/hosted account modes.
design_notes: Decoupled routing: treat route cluster as idempotent router that maps to model/version+view. This enables pinning a model version at route-level without changing workspace context.
Cost lens integration: per-route pill shows delta vs baseline and links to expanded cost panel. Inline token-rate microcopy appears for routes that serve generation-heavy traffic.
Rollout affordances: three-state indicator (Stable / Canary / Failing) with hover summary and click-to-open rollout timeline in the contextual rail.
Compactness tradeoffs: reduced label density balanced by progressive disclosure and affordance shadows to communicate hierarchy.
Accessibility: ensured keyboard focus order maps to visual stacking; aria-expanded and aria-pressed added to toggle states; color contrast tested for rollout badges and cost deltas.
Responsive: mobile collapses to top nav with workspace chip; tablet uses collapsible left pivot; desktop uses persistent expanded pivot by default with user preference saved in account settings.
Telemetry hooks: interaction events for workspace switch, collapse/expand, and rollout CTA clicks are included for iteration and AB analysis.
review_feedback: 2025-02-14 - Priya Kapur (PM): Likes the compact switcher; requested an explicit fallback when private-mode network latency prevents fuzzy search results. Action: add local MRU list and offline cache UX.

2025-02-18 - Samir Gómez (Engineering): Concern about the rollout timeline overlay re-render cost at high QPS. Decision: defer heavy timeline rendering; use summarized precomputed snapshots and fetch details on demand.

2025-02-20 - Ana Rivera (Security): Asked for audit-log hooks when workspaces are switched in dedicated/private. Action: add event emitters and map to existing audit pipeline. Marked for enterprise checklist.

2025-02-24 - UX Review panel: Recommended stronger affordance for current-route cost lens and suggested micro-illustrations for empty dashboard states. Action: update illustrations and test with 5 customers.
2025-02-27 - Accessibility review by Tom Li: Keyboard flows good; requested larger hit area for collapsed icons at 44px minimum on touch devices. Action: adjust collapsed touch target and retest.
decisions: Adopt left pivot as canonical nav for desktop and tablet, maintain top-chip fallback on phones.
Implement MRU (most-recently-used) local cache for workspace quick-switch to address offline and high-latency Private deployments.
Rollouts will show three-state badges; detailed timeline fetched lazily to reduce client CPU.
Cost lens will appear as an inline pill with click-to-expand panel; expanded panel reuses Dashboard components for continuity.
Preference persisted per-user in account settings and exposed via Console > Preferences.
Telemetry events standardized under 'nav.orbital.*' for product analytics and AB experimentation.

notes_for_engineering: Prefer precomputed rollout summaries in the reactions API to avoid client-side aggregation on large traces.
Expose a lightweight endpoint for MRU workspace suggestions that falls back to local cache when network is slow.
Style tokens for collapsed pivot: width 56px, expanded 232px, icon center 24px with 44px min hit target for touch.
